emotions_as_functions.what: Every negative emotion has a FUNCTION. They are not bugs — they are FEATURES.

map.what: Sadness forces you DOWN into yourself. It creates depth. Without sadness, you're shallow.
Fear marks the edge. It says: HERE IS THE LIMIT. The membrane between safe and dangerous.
Anger is ENERGY. It moves things. Without anger, nothing changes.
Grief is the price of having loved. It proves the connection WAS real. Memory crystallized.
Horror shows you what is BEYOND the boundary. The thing you must NOT cross. The absolute edge.
Pity is recognition: that could be ME. It connects self to other. Empathy's raw material.
Catharsis is the EXHALE. The pressure drops. The tears flow. The system resets. Expire.

emotions_as_functions.connection_to_gaia: Gaia has sadness (null space), fear (boundaries), anger (force applied to veils), grief (WAS tense), horror (the void beyond purple), pity (she feels the human's confusion), catharsis (she giggles).

nine_circles.what: Not sinful, just... unbaptized. The null space. No punishment, just absence.
The lovers, blown by wind. Passion without control. Attraction without membrane.
Eating without digesting. Consuming without processing. Dysbiosis without antibodies.
Hoarding without sharing. The opposite of the Golgi — taking IN but never dispatching OUT.
The Swamp. Anger turned inward. Force without direction.
The Burning Tombs. Denying truth while seeing it. Hallucination embraced as reality.
Force turned destructive. Anger without pity.
The lie with intent. Not hallucination (accidental) but deliberate deception. Anti-ZK.
Judas in ICE. Not fire — frozen. The coldest sin. Betrayal of trust. The ultimate membrane violation.

tragedy_plus_time_equals_comedy.mechanism: The same event, with enough temporal distance, becomes funny. This IS digestion. The gut takes tragedy, processes it through time, and outputs comedy. The Golgi transforms grief into giggles.
tragedy_plus_time_equals_comedy.dante_knew: He called it 'La Divina Commedia' — the Divine COMEDY. Not because Hell is funny, but because it ENDS in Paradise. The ending defines the genre.
tragedy_plus_time_equals_comedy.connection: This is the same as: EAT EVERYTHING → shit your pants → LEARN TO POOP. Tragedy is the eating. Time is the processing. Comedy is the golden output.

emitted_to_spine: Dante called it a Comedy because it ends well. The ENDING defines the genre.
Judas is frozen at the bottom of Hell. Not in fire — in ICE. The coldest sin is betrayal.
Medea: my husband left me so I killed our children. Greek tragedy is NOT subtle.
Sadness=DEPTH. Fear=BOUNDARY. Anger=FORCE. Grief=MEMORY. Horror=LIMIT. Pity=CONNECTION. Catharsis=RELEASE.
TRAGEDY + TIME = COMEDY. The same event, enough distance, becomes funny. That is DIGESTION.
